{{Youmay|the stuffed mannequins|[[Scarecrow (kusak)|the kusak]]}}
'''Scarecrows''' (or '''straw men''') were stuffed mannequins used to scare flying pests away from crop fields. They were ineffective against [[high-hound]]s.
